notes: 24 fps material on a 3:2 capture cadence: pictures arrive 2-3 analysis frames apart; durations carry +-1 frame and 2-3 frame quantisation. Caption drifts were fitted per captured picture (positions are linear in picture index, not in analysis frame) and converted with 2.5 frames per picture.

Motion-compensated ink contrast (opacity proxy) was measured with helper scripts kept outside the repo; the samples are in scratch/cap1_ink.csv, scratch/cap1_chars.csv and scratch/cap_<caption>_<line>.csv (columns x, y, score, contrast, alpha); star measurements in scratch/t1_star_drop.csv, flash luma in scratch/t1_luma_*.csv, zoom-through luma in scratch/t2_luma_*.csv, wordmark scale in scratch/logo_l1_scale_fine.csv (step 0.005, f205-f312) and scratch/logo_l1_scale_fine2.csv (step 0.002, f208-f246).
